audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart said Skill at Levels 2, 3, 4-5, First item and 2+ items and gave Gragas Level 6 at 3.5/10 — while the prose on the same page says Garen wins every one of those stages and that Demacian Justice cleanly beats him at 6.
audit.why: Win rate is 55.03% over 2199 games, the packet chart reads Garen/Garen/Garen/Garen/Garen/Garen/Skill, and whys[1] through whys[5] all describe Garen winning. The chart contradicted the win rate, the packet AND its own why-text simultaneously.
audit.corrected: Whole chart flipped as one group to Garen through First item, Skill at 2+ items, with ratings raised to match, and the two summary lines rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Drunken Rage (W) was described twice as a shield / 'passive shielding'. Happy Hour (P), his actual healing, was never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot's text: Drunken Rage is a 1-second drink on a flat 5s cooldown giving bonus damage on the next attack and reducing damage received — damage reduction, not a shield. The sustain that actually fights Garen's grind is Happy Hour (P), which heals on every skill cast. Calling the W a shield sends the player to the wrong counterplay.
audit.corrected: W restated as damage reduction with its 5s cooldown; Happy Hour named as the heal, with Grievous Wounds attached to extended trades.

audit.whatIsWrong: Body Slam was listed at 13s flat.
audit.why: It is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12 — 13s is only rank 3. Rank 1 is 14s, and that is the window a level-3-to-5 Garen actually plays against.
audit.corrected: Real 14s-at-rank-1 / 12s-maxed range written into report[5], dosFull[0].t and mid.

audit.why: Body Slam is both his escape and his engage, so its 14s is correctly identified as the punish window; I only made the number concrete.

The packet's suspectNames flagged 'Drunken Rage' and 'Explosive Cask' as probable wrong names. Both are the correct Riot names — these are the documented false positives. No change made on that basis.

notes: The level-chart flip is proposed as one atomic group: win[1]-win[5] plus phases[1]-[6] sides and ratings, plus the two summary lines. It is the largest correction on this matchup — the old chart had Gragas winning Level 6 at 3.5/10 on a page whose own text says Demacian Justice cleanly executes him, on a 55% matchup. Whether Explosive Cask's knockback can interrupt Judgment's spin or displace a Garen mid-R is not answerable from the kit files; I left that alone rather than assert it. Full-layer winCon/enemyWin/tradeGood/breakdown.trading carry PDF scrape residue ('Garen Top Lane Matchup Database (1-70) 24'). Note also that winCon and report[1].t are truncated mid-number ('Level 6 Gragas 6.') and will still read wrong after the chart flip — they are generated summaries that need regeneration, not a prose edit.
